pull.title: KAFKA-21365: Add separate test file to ensure the three deprecated subscribe methods are covered
pull.body:
Add separate test file to ensure the three deprecated subscribe methods are covered

Reviewers: Aditya Kousik <akousik@apple.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

review_comments.body: Can we continue to verify the right exception is thrown for CLASSIC against subscription pattern to make sure existing behaviour is maintained? Right now, it's a blind spot by _not_ invoking the method
For parity, the other Plaintext Consumer Callback test checks for the right partitions being invoked and not just that they were invoked
Missing onPartitionsLost to flow through the 2-arg listener
You can also verify that if you create a ConsumerRebalanceListener that overrides the 2-arg parameters then the 1-arg variants are _not_ invoked since this class extends RebalanceListener
